page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_8_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. Powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features an x86_64 architecture with 416 dedicated Intel vCPUs. It is equipped with 7600.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 18.27 GB of RAM per core.

The instance includes 410 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Designed for extreme memory-intensive workloads, this server is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, massive enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data warehousing operations. Its high resource density offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive memory footprints on a single virtualized node without the overhead of distributed clustering.
